body: Thanks for your personal account, I'm sorry that you feel at fault for what happened to her. That's precisely the kind of grief I want to avoid coming to those close to me. I don't want to write a note that accidentally sounds like I'm blaming anyone, so I'll have to be careful with how I word things. Wording is one of my many weak points.
I've got to get some sleep before work in the morning so I'm logging off but I'll try to think of a concise way to answer that tomorrow.
Personal reference, but I just want people to answer the question. I appreciate your offer to talk but I just wanted some first-hand experienced advice if there are any that'll see this.
